title: Debug overlay — the loop-proving ticket (M0 exit test)
summary: The trivial end-to-end ticket that proves the autonomous loop: a Bot builds a debug overlay, gj-qa-release attaches a screenshot, the Coordinator merges, and no human types anything between ticket creation and merge. The overlay is compiled out of release builds.

acceptance_tests.test: Overlay toggles with a three-finger tap on device and F3 in the Editor or on a gamepad; shows fps (1 s average and p99 over 5 s), frame time ms, build version, git short SHA, scene name, device model. It also has a 'save performance report' action that writes fps p50/p99 over the last 60 s, device model, and build to the app's Documents folder and the share sheet, so the Owner's device measurements are one tap.
Overlay is excluded from release builds via the GJ_DEBUG scripting define (an EditMode test asserting the type is absent in release is suggested).
Built with UI Toolkit, anchored top-right inside the safe area, no taller than 8 % of the screen in landscape, readable on a bright and a dark scan (scrim behind text).
PR timeline shows: ticket assigned by the Foreman → Bot branch and PR → gj-qa-release evidence → Coordinator review and merge, with no human commits or comments.
acceptance_tests.evidence: PR timeline link recorded in governance/CHECKPOINTS/M0.md
